title: What is Prefix caching?
description: Prefix caching reuses stored attention work across requests that share the same opening tokens. How it hits, and how builders keep it hot.
lead: Prefix caching keeps the attention state computed for a request's opening tokens so a later request with the same byte-identical prefix reuses it instead of recomputing prefill. It saves GPU compute across requests, fires only on exact prefix matches, and rewards stable-content-first prompt layouts.
